text: dsh-skill-pack 是一组面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作流 skills。插件入口向 DSH 的 skills 服务注册文件系统 provider，从包内目录发现这些提示型工作流，并与项目和用户已有 skills 并存。内容涵盖会话 preset 选型、技能路由、对话交接、issue 与 PR 分诊、需求规格和阻塞关系明确的 tickets、跨会话决策地图、教学及通宵执行流程。适合希望在 DSH 中复用工程规划和协作流程的用户；按 README 需安装到 DSH profile，不需要额外 API key。

dsh-skill-pack adds workflow prompts to DSH through a filesystem provider. They guide preset selection, handoffs, issue triage, specs, linked tickets, decision maps, teaching, and overnight work. Install in a DSH profile; no API key is declared.
想给 DSH 加一套能帮我选择会话模式的流程指导。
我有一堆新 issue 和外部 PR，怎么分类并整理成可处理的 brief？
帮我把讨论过的需求整理成规格说明，再拆成有依赖顺序的任务。
我想把当前会话的背景交给另一个 agent 继续做，怎么整理交接？
大型项目还没想清楚路线时，如何先列决策并逐步推进？
不知道该用哪个工作流 skill 时，能不能根据我的情况帮我选？
How can I turn a rough project idea into a map of decisions before implementation?
Can I hand the current conversation to a fresh agent with a concise summary?
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「会话模式路由」：根据任务类型比较 standard、code、minimal 和 cordis preset，并说明何时建议新开会话。
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「会话交接」：把当前对话整理成供新 agent 接续的文档，提示引用已有产物，并要求删去敏感信息。
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「Issue 与 PR 分诊」：按 bug 或 enhancement 分类，并将事项推进到待评估、待补信息或可交给 agent 等状态。
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「规格与 tickets」：将既有讨论整理为规格，或切成独立可验证且声明阻塞依赖的纵向任务。

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · dsh-skill-pack：A shareable set of **12 workflow skills** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). One plugin, one `FileSystemSkillProvider`, twelve skills.

The pack is a single-package `dsh` plugin (the same shape as a Hermes / DSH community bundle). Installing it registers a filesystem skill provider that points at the `skills/` directory bundled inside this package — **added alongside** your own project and user skills, never replacing them.

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · Requirements：- `dsh` >= **0.1.0-rc.6**

This package declares **no** `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency. Like other DSH bundles, the official packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`, etc.) are injected by your profile's closure at boot time, so the plugin resolves them from the profile's own `node_modules`.

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · The 12 skills：| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-mode-routing` | DSH session mode (agent preset) selection and routing — the four built-in presets (`standard` / `code` / `minimal` / `cordis`) plus user-built presets. |
| `handoff` | Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. |
| `triage` | Move issues and external PRs through a triage state machine — categorise, verify, grill, and write agent-ready briefs. |
| `to-spec` | Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker. |
| `to-tickets` | Break a plan, spec, or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges. |
| `wayfinder` | Plan a huge chunk of work as a shared map of decision tickets on the issue tracker. |
| `wait-what` | Stop — that last message did not land; re-pitch it. |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept, within the workspace. |
| `ask-matt` | Ask which skill or flow fits your situation — a router over the shared skills set plus the user's own skills. |

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · Install：Choose one of the three install forms. Replace `web` with whichever profile you use (`web`, `headless`, `tui`, `acp`, …).

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · Local path (file:)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-skill-pack
```

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to `pnpm` inside the profile directory and then reconciles the profile's bundle list, so any spec `pnpm add` accepts works here.

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm`, so `remove` is `pnpm remove` (alias `pnpm rm`): it drops the dependency from the profile's `package.json` and `node_modules`, and `dsh` then removes the bundle from the profile's layer list. If your `dsh` build lacks `remove` forwarding, delete the dependency from the profile's `package.json` and re-run `dsh plugin --profile web install`.

@jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack README · How it works：Because `includeDefaultRoots` stays at its default (`true`), the shared skills join the provider's discovery ranks as a custom root (rank 300) — below project roots and above user roots — so your own skills keep working alongside them.
